purpose: Attempt method/target/result reproduction, not independent biological replication

miRNA.input: Deposited quantile-normalized continuous signal; same 1245 features as the primary analysis; 9 arrays, 3 per group
miRNA.candidate: One-way three-group ANOVA with residual df = 6; pairwise LSD uses pooled within-group MSE; the protected gate is reported separately
miRNA.multiplicity: Raw pairwise p and BH within 1245 features per contrast exported separately; separate ANOVA family
miRNA.scale: Signal-unit mean differences; no invented log2 scale or fold-change ratios
miRNA.zero_within_group_variance: Nonpositive or numerically zero residual MSE produces withheld tests
miRNA.heatmap: 20 largest-variance features among six control/high-dose arrays plus prespecified miR-574-5p if absent; row z scores (ddof = 1), average linkage and Euclidean distance, fixed columns C1–C3/H1–H3; original Figure 6a selection unreported

ozone.candidate_designs: All nine candidates are prespecified in replicate_mirna_ozone.R; marginal genotype/age/exposure, additive genotype sensitivity, six-animal old O3 genotype and four 6-animal within-stratum exposures
ozone.normalization: Existing effective-length/size factors retained from full 24-library tximport dataset; refit dispersions per model/subset; inheritance differs from unknown original preprocessing
ozone.filter: Fixed primary 18537-gene filter: ≥10 rounded fragments in ≥3 of 24 libraries; original author filter unknown
ozone.outliers: DESeq2 default minReplicatesForReplace = 7 for author-style candidates; flagged gene counts recorded; no sample removals
ozone.inference: Convergence checked, Cook filter enabled, independent filtering disabled for complete BH families; source-specific nominal .3/.1 effect criteria applied to unshrunken MLEs
ozone.gene_matching: Exact symbols only; duplicated candidate symbols represented by highest baseMean (then gene ID), independently of p/effect; nonmatches retained in coverage accounting
ozone.figure1_style: UpSet counts use one exact-symbol shared universe testable in all 3 candidate factor models and present in the author full genotype gene index; not pooled causal or interaction inference
limitations: Original exact design/filter/GeneSpring project not deposited
Author S3 is a selected list; agreement conditional on selection
Same-source reanalysis is not independent biological replication
No inferred BBB function, cognition or cell-specific response from bulk expression

figures: All individual miRNA animals shown; pointwise 95% intervals distinguished from FDR; full scatter ranges and exact-match denominators; all 7 nonempty UpSet factor patterns, including zeros
